newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Republicans lose key state senate races.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Republicans lose key state senate races.

text.p: Vermont Democrats, who won all their statewide races and beat enough Republicans in the state Senate to win a majority for the first time since 1990, succeeded in ousting two key Republicans from the Senate.
Senate President Stephen Webster of Orange County and Appropriations Committee Chairman Tom McCauley of Rutland county lost their re-election races to the Democrats.

In a sign of the Democrats' new strength, Gov. Howard Dean met Democratic leaders Wednesday to discuss the coming legislative session. But Dean said Republican senate leaders were not invited because two of their leaders were defeated in Tuesday's elections.
